subject: Hosted API architecture brief — scheduling & timezone handoff
messages:
From: Alex Jones <alex.jones@integral.health>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@integral.health>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API integration deep dive — request for technical session

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the demo last week — our engineering team liked the latency numbers and the streaming demo. We'd like to follow up with a technical deep-dive focused on the Hosted API integration: SDKs, streaming best practices, and how function/tool calling should be modeled for our use case (medical record redaction + protected field enrichment). Two asks from our side:

1) A one-hour architecture review with your infra/product engineers where we can validate expected token flow and retry/fallback behavior.
2) A short checklist for pre-work (token scopes, network egress considerations, and a quick runbook for debugging streaming).

Our core attendees will be myself (platform lead) and Sarah (integration PM). We are in EST. Proposed windows that work for us the week of Nov 22: mornings PT (8–11am PT) or afternoons ET (1–4pm ET).

Can you propose 2–3 slots and an agenda? Also please include any required artifacts we should share ahead of time.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Jones
Platform Lead, Integral Health
alex.jones@integral.health

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jones <alex.jones@integral.health>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@integral.health>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API integration deep dive — request for technical session

Hi Alex — great to hear the demo landed. Happy to run the deep-dive. Proposed plan and logistics below.

High-level agenda (attached as PDF):
- 5 min: Introductions and desired outcomes
- 20 min: Hosted API architecture walkthrough (request routing, streaming, KV/prefix caching)
- 15 min: SDK integration patterns (sync vs streaming, token refresh, backpressure)
- 10 min: Tool/function calling & structured outputs (best practices for schema validation and retries)
- 10 min: Q&A + next steps / mutual action items

Suggested 60-minute slots (PT):
- Tue Nov 23 @ 9:00am PT (12:00pm ET)
- Wed Nov 24 @ 11:00am PT (2:00pm ET)

Internal attendees I expect will join: Marissa Cole (solutions engineer) and Karthik Iyer (runtime PM). If you need additional folks from our security or SRE team, flag that and we can loop them in.

Attachments: Integral-Health-Proposed-Agenda.pdf, hosted-api-arch-diagram-v2.png (high-level diagram).

Pre-work request: if you can share (1) a short list of integration requirements around PII/SSN redaction and (2) a sample request/response pattern you expect from the client side, that will help us tailor the session.

If neither slot works, tell me two exact times you prefer (including timezone) and we'll try to accommodate.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

Looping in a couple of quick notes from my side:
- We should allocate 10 mins to the streaming test harness (how to validate partial responses and resume after network blips).
- Recommend asking for an IAM/admin contact if they want examples of scoped API keys for staging vs prod.

Slot note: I have a customer Q later on Nov 23, but I can join at 12:00pm PT for the session if it is strictly 60 minutes. If Integral prefers a slightly later time, we can do Wed Nov 24 11:00am PT — either works for me.

Thanks — will prepare a short demo snippet for the SDK streaming flow.

- Can you include dial-in details (we use Google Meet) and an ICS calendar invite?
- We'll attach a short SSO/SSO-assertion requirements doc and a sample request payload. See attached: integral-sso-requirements.pdf.

Alex
